Nevertheless, he joined Cassius in the plot against Caesar." This refers to Lucius Junius Brutus. While Gaius Cassius Longinus is also mentioned as being praetor peregrinus in 44 BC, the specific phrasing "he joined Cassius" in the provided texts points to Brutus as the person who held the urban praetorship and subsequently joined the conspiracy led by Cassius.
